json.title: Endless Coastal Summer
json.logline: A glowing gouache memory of a summer drive to the ocean edge where time stood still.

palette: soft sage green in distant foliage
character_rules: one protagonist appears in every scene with the same face, hair length and build
wardrobe is identical from the first scene to the last
the face stays readable in at least three-quarter profile
style_bible.lighting: cinematic low-angle golden-hour light with gentle halation and soft falloff
style_bible.medium: loose gouache painting with visible brush strokes and softly blended colour

events.visual: Felt piano notes begin as a young woman leans against a coastal highway railing.
Gouache textures spread into a wide view of a convertible coasting down a cliffside road.
Ocean breeze blows through hair as sunlit foam sparkles against blue-violet waves.
Tight close-up of smiling eyes bathed in amber sunset rim light.
Explosion of golden light across a vast sunlit beach with waves crashing in gouache spray.
Fragmented memories of beach wildflowers and spinning under sunset skies.
Soft glow dims as the woman gazes peacefully at the calm horizon.
Single piano chord fades into silence over warm milky cream dusk light.

scenes.camera_note: Slow gentle push toward the woman resting against a wooden guardrail.
scenes.action: A young woman with wavy dark brown hair rests against a coastal highway guardrail.
scenes.setting: A quiet coastal turnout overlooking misty headlands in soft early evening light.

scenes.camera_note: Lateral drift emphasizing painterly gouache depth between wildflowers and winding asphalt.
scenes.action: A vintage convertible coasts along a winding coastal highway bordered by wild sage foliage.
scenes.setting: Cliffside ocean highway framed by sun-bleached terracotta dirt banks and distant sea spray.

scenes.camera_note: Tilt up from seafoam ripples to the woman's windblown profile.
scenes.action: Warm ocean wind sweeps dark wavy hair across the woman's glowing profile.
scenes.setting: An open-top car passenger seat overlooking turquoise and deep blue-violet ocean breakers.

scenes.camera_note: Rapid intimate push into her sunlit expression.
scenes.action: The woman turns her face toward the low golden sun with a joyful smile.
scenes.setting: Close profile against a radiant sky painted in rose sunset hues and cream highlights.

scenes.camera_note: Sweeping wide pull-out revealing the infinite coastal horizon under golden light.
scenes.action: The woman stands barefoot on wet beach sand as golden surf rushes past her feet.
scenes.setting: An immense, endless sandy coast under dramatic golden-hour sunlight and painterly sea spray.

scenes.camera_note: Multi-layered floating drift between coastal memories.
scenes.action: Gouache brushstrokes blend impressions of coastal wildflowers and sparkling ocean waves.
scenes.setting: A warm collaged canvas of sun-drenched beach grass, ocean spray, and twilight skies.

scenes.camera_note: Slow steady backward retreat as nightfall settles.
scenes.action: The woman stands still watching twilight settle over calm distant ocean waters.
scenes.setting: Dusk coastline illuminated by lingering milky cream light and deep blue-violet shadows.
